properties.name: Ten Thousand Islands and Everglades mangrove coast demo AOI
properties.source: Box over the Ten Thousand Islands, Florida (Collier County), the mangrove coast between Everglades City and the northern edge of Everglades National Park
properties.years_note: year_a is 2020, not the brief's 2018: ESA WorldCover, the mangrove reference this build can reach, exists for 2020 and 2021 only, and the brief's 2018 needs Global Mangrove Watch v3, whose host (zenodo.org) is blocked here.
